name: Le Vasa cable landing station (Tafuna CLS)
developer: ASTCA (American Samoa Telecommunications Authority); modular CLS by DXN
notes: FCC public notices (DA-26-578A1, DA-26-296A1) state ASTCA will construct a cable landing station and beach joint in Tafuna, Tutuila and own/operate the Le Vasa system connecting to Google/Starfish Bulikula (BU 1A); FCC OIA approved the application June 2026. Samoa News (2026-07-07) reports DXN won an AU$1m (~US$690k) contract to design/manufacture/deliver/commission the modular CLS hosting Le Vasa, delivery due March 2027; system expected operational Q3 2026. Per methodology this is telecom_cable_station/connectivity infrastructure, NOT a commercial datacenter (no colo/rack hosting service confirmed).

name: ASTCA headquarters cable landing station relocation / data-center-grade building
notes: DOI Office of Insular Affairs ASTCA/ASG infrastructure-broadband document: current cable landing station sits on an unsecured golf-course village site; ASTCA proposes relocation to a government-fenced ASTCA headquarters building 'properly engineered and built for safe and secure data center operations'. Official plan-level evidence of a data-center-grade telecom core facility in the Tafuna/Pago Pago corridor; no commercial colo service confirmed.

name: ASTCA core network / NOC (Tafuna-Pago Pago)
notes: ASTCA official pages confirm the state telecom operator's fiber broadband, 5G, business services and Hawaiki circuits across inhabited islands, with network core/NOC and RFP surface; no public colocation/hosting product page confirmed. Classified telecom_core per methodology: operator/service evidence is not facility evidence for commercial colo. Negative baseline: no AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI region entry for American Samoa on official region lists (checked 2026-08-12), no ASPA large-load/datacenter power evidence found, no verified neutral commercial colocation market.

name: SAS-2 cable project (ASTCA/MCIT)
notes: Samoa News reports Office of the Governor and ASTCA concluded a 3-day mission with MCIT to develop the formal plan for the SAS-2 project, including breaking ground on physical requirements for the SAS-2 cable. Planned regional connectivity project; no landing station site, contract or permit named yet, so no facility-level record beyond planned status (telecom/connectivity, not commercial DC).
